beginner.summary: For developers, analysts and junior DBAs new to MySQL. Covers installation and tools, databases and storage engines, data types, constraints, queries, joins, aggregation and window functions, subqueries and CTEs, data changes and upserts, views, indexes, InnoDB transactions, users and privileges, stored programs, triggers and events, JSON, loading data, logical backups and connecting applications.
prerequisites: Knows what tables, rows and columns are
outcomes: Install MySQL and work in MySQL Shell and Workbench
Design tables and write SQL with joins, aggregates, CTEs and JSON
Secure databases with users, roles and privileges
Back up, restore and connect applications safely

days.topic: MySQL Overview, Versions and Installation Setup
subtopics: What MySQL is and where it is used
MySQL Community, Enterprise, MariaDB and Percona Server
Release model: LTS and innovation releases
Installing MySQL 8.4 on Linux, Windows and Docker
The mysql client and MySQL Shell
The data directory and configuration files
Starting, stopping and checking the server
days.lab_task: Install MySQL natively and in Docker, secure the root account, connect with the client, MySQL Shell and Workbench, load Sakila and record the version, data directory and configuration file.
days.deliverable: Install notes and a server information sheet

subtopics: Creating databases and choosing character sets
days.lab_task: Create a shop database with utf8mb4, build customers, products and orders tables in InnoDB, alter them as requirements change and inspect them through information_schema.
days.deliverable: DDL script and schema description
checks: Insert an emoji in a name
Stored and returned correctly with utf8mb4
Engine and row format shown for each table

subtopics: Choosing types for size and correctness
days.lab_task: Store prices as DECIMAL and FLOAT and compare totals, store event times in DATETIME and TIMESTAMP across time zones and replace an ENUM with a lookup table.
days.deliverable: Script with results and a type choice note
checks: Sum prices in DECIMAL and FLOAT
DECIMAL exact and FLOAT shows rounding
TIMESTAMP shifts and DATETIME does not
ENUM values moved to a referenced table

subtopics: Foreign keys and ON DELETE actions
days.lab_task: Add keys, foreign keys and checks to the shop schema, insert bad data with strict mode off and on and record the difference.
days.deliverable: Constraint script and test results
checks: Insert an order for a missing customer
Insert a too-long name without strict mode
Insert the same name with strict mode

subtopics: NULL handling with IFNULL and COALESCE
days.lab_task: Answer ten questions on Sakila, including paged film lists, customers without email, films matching a pattern and rentals labelled by length with CASE.
days.deliverable: Query file and results

subtopics: Emulating FULL OUTER JOIN with UNION
days.lab_task: Report rentals with customer, film and store, list films never rented, emulate a full outer join between two lists and fix a join that doubles payments.
days.deliverable: Query file and results

subtopics: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX
days.lab_task: Report revenue by store and month with ROLLUP, rank films by rentals within categories, compute running totals and fix a query rejected by ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY.
days.deliverable: Query file and results

days.lab_task: Walk a category tree with a recursive CTE, get the latest three rentals per customer and rewrite a nested report as a chain of CTEs.
days.deliverable: Query file and results
checks: CTE version returns the same rows

days.topic: Changing Data: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and Upserts
subtopics: REPLACE and why to be careful
days.lab_task: Upsert a product feed with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, show how REPLACE deletes and reinserts rows, update prices with a join and delete old carts in batches.
days.deliverable: DML script and results
checks: Use REPLACE on a row with children
All old carts removed in small batches

days.lab_task: Create a reporting view of sales, grant a reporting user access to the view only, add CHECK OPTION to an updatable view and compare view algorithms in EXPLAIN.
days.deliverable: View definitions and tests
checks: Query the base table as the reporting user
Update through the view outside its filter

subtopics: Composite indexes and the leftmost prefix
days.lab_task: Load a million orders, time three slow queries, read their EXPLAIN output, add composite and covering indexes and compare.
days.deliverable: Before and after EXPLAIN output and timings

subtopics: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and SKIP LOCKED
days.lab_task: Show uncommitted changes staying invisible in another session, reserve stock with FOR UPDATE, build a job queue with SKIP LOCKED and read a deadlock report.
days.deliverable: Session transcripts and deadlock report

days.lab_task: Create an application account limited to the shop database and its subnet, a read-only reporting role, password rules and a locked account for a leaver.
days.deliverable: Security script and access tests

subtopics: When to keep logic in the application
days.lab_task: Write a procedure that places an order with stock checks and error handlers, a function that calculates discounts and a procedure using a prepared statement for searches.
days.deliverable: Procedure and function code and tests
checks: Pass an injection string to the search

days.lab_task: Add an audit trigger for price changes, a trigger that keeps stock counts current and a nightly event that removes expired carts.
days.deliverable: Trigger and event code and results

days.lab_task: Store product attributes as JSON, query nested values, turn JSON arrays into rows with JSON_TABLE, index tags with a multi-valued index and validate documents.
days.deliverable: Queries, indexes and results

days.lab_task: Load a 2-million-row CSV with LOAD DATA and with MySQL Shell parallel import, clean it in staging, export a report and compare load times.
days.deliverable: Load scripts, export file and timing table
checks: Load a file with bad rows

subtopics: MySQL Shell dump and load utilities
days.lab_task: Back up the shop database with mysqldump and MySQL Shell, restore into a new server, restore one table after a mistake and compare speed.
days.deliverable: Backup files, restore commands and timings

subtopics: Connectors for Python, Java, PHP and Node.js
days.lab_task: Write a small service that lists products and places orders with parameterised queries, a pool and a transaction, and demonstrate why string-built SQL is unsafe.
days.deliverable: Application code and injection demonstration
checks: Parameterised query treats it as data

days.lab_task: Build an online shop database with constraints, indexes, views, procedures, triggers, JSON attributes and roles, write ten reports, connect a small application, back it up and restore it.
days.deliverable: Scripts, reports, application code and restore evidence
checks: Correct results within one second each
Application works on the restored database
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one database

intermediate.summary: For DBAs and developers who run MySQL. Covers configuration and the buffer pool, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, index design, the slow query log, Performance Schema and sys, InnoDB internals, locking, replication with GTIDs, semi-synchronous and multi-source replication, XtraBackup and point-in-time recovery, partitioning, online schema changes, security, ProxySQL, InnoDB Cluster, monitoring with PMM, managed MySQL, upgrades and MySQL Shell utilities.
prerequisites: Writes SQL with joins, CTEs and window functions in MySQL
Creates users, indexes and logical backups
outcomes: Tune queries and configuration from evidence
Run replication, physical backups and point-in-time recovery
Change schemas online and route traffic with ProxySQL
Run InnoDB Cluster and managed MySQL and upgrade safely

days.topic: Server Configuration and the InnoDB Buffer Pool
days.lab_task: Size the buffer pool and redo log for a 16 GB server, persist a dynamic change, measure buffer pool hit rate under load and turn on the slow query log.
days.deliverable: Configuration changes with reasons and measurements

days.lab_task: Read the plans of five slow queries with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, find a filesort, a temporary table and a bad join order, and use the optimizer trace to see why an index was skipped.
days.deliverable: Annotated plans
checks: Reason for skipping the index found

subtopics: Indexes for ORDER BY and GROUP BY
days.lab_task: Tune five queries with composite, functional and descending indexes, test dropping an index safely by making it invisible and replace OFFSET pagination with keyset pagination.
days.deliverable: Tuning log with plans and timings
checks: Keyset page fast and OFFSET slow
Query on an expression uses it

days.topic: The Slow Query Log and pt-query-digest
days.lab_task: Capture an hour of workload in the slow log, analyse it with pt-query-digest, rank queries by total time and build a tuning backlog for the top five.
days.deliverable: Digest report and tuning backlog
checks: Top queries ranked by total time
Fix proposed for each top query

days.topic: Performance Schema and the sys Schema
days.lab_task: Use sys views to find the heaviest statements, tables with full scans, unused and redundant indexes and the biggest memory users.
days.deliverable: Findings report

days.lab_task: Grow the history list with a long transaction, watch purge catch up when it ends, compare flushing under two settings and explain each section of InnoDB status.
days.deliverable: Status output and notes

days.lab_task: Reproduce gap lock blocking under repeatable read, find blockers with sys.innodb_lock_waits, log every deadlock and remove one by changing access order.
days.deliverable: Session transcripts, lock output and fixes
checks: Deadlocks written to the error log
Deadlock no longer occurs under load

subtopics: Cloning a replica with the clone plugin
days.lab_task: Build a source and two replicas with GTIDs using the clone plugin, run reads on a replica, measure lag under load and promote a replica.
days.deliverable: Configuration, lag measurements and switch steps
checks: Other replica follows the new source

days.lab_task: Turn on semi-synchronous replication, combine two sources into one reporting replica, add a one-hour delayed replica, recover a dropped table from it and check consistency.
days.deliverable: Configuration, recovery evidence and checksum report
checks: Table copied from the delayed replica

days.topic: Physical Backups with XtraBackup and Point-in-Time Recovery
days.lab_task: Take full and incremental backups with XtraBackup, drop a table by mistake and restore to one second before the drop using binary logs.
days.deliverable: Backup scripts and recovery evidence
checks: Restore time recorded against the target
objectives: Recover to a point in time

subtopics: Range, list, hash and key partitioning
days.lab_task: Partition an events table by month, show pruning, drop the oldest month instantly and exchange a partition into an archive table.
days.deliverable: Partition scripts and plans
checks: Data moved to the archive table

subtopics: Online DDL algorithms: INSTANT, INPLACE and COPY
days.lab_task: Add a column instantly, add an index in place, change a column type on a 20-million-row table with gh-ost under load and resolve a metadata lock queue.
days.deliverable: Change scripts and load test results

tools: Audit log plugin or Percona audit
days.lab_task: Require TLS for remote accounts, encrypt tablespaces and binary logs, log access to a sensitive table and review the server against a hardening checklist.
days.deliverable: Security configuration, audit log and checklist
checks: Search a data file for a known value

days.topic: Connection Routing and Query Rules with ProxySQL
days.lab_task: Put ProxySQL in front of a source and replicas, route reads to replicas, block a dangerous query pattern, cache a hot query and fail a replica.
days.deliverable: ProxySQL configuration and test results
checks: Traffic moves to the remaining replica

days.lab_task: Build a three-node InnoDB Cluster with MySQL Shell, connect through MySQL Router, kill the primary under load and add a new member.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration and failover results
checks: New primary elected and writes resume

days.lab_task: Monitor the cluster and replicas with PMM, find the top query in query analytics, act on advisor findings and alert on lag and connection use.
days.deliverable: Dashboards, findings and alerts

days.topic: Managed MySQL: RDS, Aurora, Azure and Cloud SQL
subtopics: Amazon RDS for MySQL and Aurora MySQL
Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server
days.lab_task: Create MySQL on two cloud providers, change parameters, add a replica, restore to a point in time and compare features, limits and cost.
days.deliverable: Settings, test results and comparison
checks: Restore to a point in time
New instance with data from that time
Blocked and the managed alternative used
Monthly cost for the same size

subtopics: Changes in 8.0 and 8.4 that break applications
days.lab_task: Run the upgrade checker on a 5.7 server, fix its findings, upgrade through a replica to 8.4 and switch the application with little downtime.
days.deliverable: Checker report, upgrade log and rollback plan
checks: No authentication or SQL mode errors

subtopics: MySQL Shell modes: SQL, Python and JavaScript
days.lab_task: Copy a schema between servers with Shell utilities, write a Python Shell script that reports table sizes and missing primary keys and install MySQL with an Ansible role.
days.deliverable: Scripts, Ansible role and outputs

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Replicated and Tuned Shop Platform
days.lab_task: Take over a slow, unprotected shop database: build an InnoDB Cluster behind ProxySQL, add XtraBackup with point-in-time recovery, tune the top queries from the slow log, make a schema change online and present results with a failover demo.
days.deliverable: Configuration, tuning log, recovery test and presentation
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For senior DBAs and architects running MySQL at scale. Covers InnoDB internals, high-concurrency tuning, multi-primary and ClusterSet designs, Orchestrator failover, Vitess sharding, Kubernetes operators, cross-region disaster recovery, schema changes at scale, advanced optimisation, large tables, hardening, HeatWave, migrations, fleet observability, capacity planning, automation, multi-tenant design, production incidents and running a MySQL platform.
prerequisites: Runs MySQL replication or InnoDB Cluster in production
Tunes queries and configuration from evidence
Takes physical backups and runs point-in-time recovery
outcomes: Design highly available and sharded MySQL platforms
Tune heavy workloads and change schemas safely at scale
Migrate, secure and observe MySQL fleets
Diagnose incidents and run MySQL as a platform

subtopics: Redo log design in 8.0 and later
Buffer pool LRU and flushing algorithms
days.lab_task: Measure page splits from random and sequential keys, watch adaptive flushing under a write spike and explain buffer pool behaviour from metrics.
days.deliverable: Measurements and notes
checks: More page splits with random keys
Flushing adapts and the change is recorded
Young and old sublists explained with data

days.topic: Tuning for High Concurrency and Write-Heavy Workloads
days.lab_task: Benchmark a write-heavy workload, tune redo, flushing and durability settings, redesign a hot counter and report throughput and latency for each change.
days.deliverable: Benchmark report
checks: Throughput gain and data loss risk stated
Each change justified by a measurement

days.topic: Multi-Primary Group Replication and InnoDB ClusterSet
days.lab_task: Run multi-primary Group Replication and create a write conflict, then build a ClusterSet across two regions and fail over to the second region.
days.deliverable: Configuration, conflict evidence and failover log
checks: Single or multi-primary chosen with reasons

days.lab_task: Manage replication with Orchestrator, kill the source, watch automatic promotion update ProxySQL through a hook and run a planned switchover.
days.deliverable: Orchestrator configuration and failover results
checks: Writer hostgroup updated by the hook

subtopics: When one server is not enough
Vitess architecture: VTGate, VTTablet and topology
days.lab_task: Deploy Vitess, shard a customer schema by customer ID, reshard from two to four shards online and compare single-shard and cross-shard query costs.
days.deliverable: Vitess configuration, resharding log and query comparison
checks: Cost compared with a single-shard query

subtopics: When to run MySQL on Kubernetes
tools: Percona Operator for MySQL or MySQL Operator
days.lab_task: Deploy a three-node cluster with an operator, schedule backups to object storage, delete the primary pod under load and restore a new cluster from backup.
days.deliverable: Manifests, failover evidence and restore log
checks: Writes resume on a new primary
objectives: Back up and restore on Kubernetes

days.lab_task: Add a cross-region replica and copied backups, run a DR drill that promotes the other region, fail back and automate a weekly restore test.
days.deliverable: DR plan, drill report and restore test job

days.lab_task: Set up a schema change pipeline with linting and gh-ost throttled on replica lag, run an expand and contract column rename over three releases and roll back a bad change.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, change records and rollback evidence
checks: Submit a change without a primary key
No failed requests at any step

subtopics: Derived table merging and condition pushdown
days.lab_task: Fix a bad join with a histogram, force a plan with an optimizer hint as a last resort, rewrite a query in the application with the rewrite plugin and compare plans before and after an upgrade.
days.deliverable: Plans, fixes and notes

days.lab_task: Archive two years of old orders from a 500-million-row table with pt-archiver under load, move archives to object storage and keep them queryable.
days.deliverable: Archive process, impact measurements and query examples

days.lab_task: Review a server against the CIS MySQL benchmark, fix failures, build a masked test copy and prepare audit evidence for access to card data.
days.deliverable: Benchmark results, masked database and evidence pack

days.topic: MySQL HeatWave for Analytics and Machine Learning
subtopics: Vector store and generative AI features
tools: MySQL HeatWave on OCI or AWS
days.lab_task: Load sales data into HeatWave, compare analytic query times with InnoDB, train a churn model with AutoML and estimate monthly cost.
days.deliverable: Timing comparison, model results and cost estimate
checks: HeatWave much faster for the analytic query
objectives: Run analytics and ML in MySQL

days.topic: Migrating to and Between MySQL Platforms
subtopics: Oracle and SQL Server to MySQL
Data migration with DMS or MySQL Shell
days.lab_task: Migrate a SQL Server schema to MySQL, then move a MySQL database to Aurora using replication for cutover, validating data and measuring downtime.
days.deliverable: Assessment, converted schema, validation and cutover log

days.lab_task: Monitor 20 servers with PMM and Grafana, aggregate error logs, define database SLOs and alerts and find the worst query across the fleet.
days.deliverable: Dashboards, SLOs and alerts

days.lab_task: Forecast growth for 18 months, decide when to add replicas or shards, plan archiving and estimate savings from consolidating small databases.
days.deliverable: Forecast, scaling plan and savings estimate
checks: Based on at least three months of data

days.lab_task: Automate a full cluster build with Ansible, provision managed MySQL with Terraform and schedule an automated failover test and restore test.
days.deliverable: Ansible roles, Terraform code and test pipelines
checks: Cluster ready with no manual steps

subtopics: Shared schema, schema per tenant and database per tenant
days.lab_task: Build a SaaS schema in shared and per-tenant models, migrate 500 tenant schemas, move a large tenant to its own server and compare operational effort.
days.deliverable: Two designs, migration timings and comparison

days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected incidents (a metadata lock pile-up, a connection storm, broken replication from a duplicate key, binary logs filling the disk and a plan change), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.topic: Running MySQL as a Database Platform
days.lab_task: Design a MySQL platform for 30 teams with standard builds, service levels, an onboarding guide, schema review rules and a 12-month roadmap.
days.deliverable: Platform design, onboarding guide and roadmap
checks: Availability, recovery and support times defined
Teams can get a database without asking DBAs

days.lab_task: Design and build a MySQL platform for a high-traffic shop: a cross-region topology, sharding or ClusterSet, proxies, online schema change pipeline, archiving, hardening and automation, then run a game day with region failover, a schema change and an incident.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, automation, game day report and review presentation
checks: Fail over the region in the game day
Run a schema change under load
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
